schemes.name: SBI Small Cap Fund Direct Growth
schemes.exit_load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
schemes.lock_in: None stated on the Groww page (not an ELSS scheme).
schemes.fund_managers: Pradeep Kesavan (Dec 2023 - Present); Rama Iyer Srinivasan (Nov 2013 - Present)
schemes.objective: The scheme seeks to provide investors with opportunities for long-term growth in capital along with the liquidity of an open-ended scheme by investing predominantly in a well diversified basket of equity stocks of small cap companies.

schemes.fund_managers: Bhavin Vithlani (Apr 2024 - Present); Pradeep Kesavan (Dec 2023 - Present)
schemes.objective: The scheme aims to provide investors with opportunities for long term growth in capital along with the liquidity of an open-ended scheme by investing predominantly in a well-diversified basket of equity stocks of Midcap companies.

schemes.name: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Growth
schemes.tax_implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%. Groww labels this scheme ELSS with a 3Y lock-in.
schemes.objective: The scheme seeks capital appreciation through investments in equities, cumulative convertible preference shares and fully convertible debentures and bonds. The scheme was converted into an open-ended plan in November 1999.

definitions_from_groww_pages.expense_ratio: A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses.
definitions_from_groww_pages.exit_load: A fee payable to a mutual fund house for exiting a fund (fully or partially) before the completion of a specified period from the date of investment.
definitions_from_groww_pages.stamp_duty: A form of tax payable for the purchase or sale of an asset or security.
definitions_from_groww_pages.tax: A percentage of your capital gains payable to the government upon exiting your mutual fund investments. Taxation is categorized as long-term capital gains (LTCG) and short-term capital gains (STCG) depending on your holding period and the type of fund.
